name: switch
title: Switch
description: Settings that take effect immediately, such as alerts or visibility.

motionProfile.reason: The thumb travels only within its measured track, the track and the thumb each own one scoped palette, and an explicit size revision remeasures the endpoint.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Switch owns one opacity entrance on a later-inserted root; a presenting parent, a hidden host or an unusable control keeps native paint.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Switch owns the thumb endpoint revision on its own indicator: the measured travel with a non-overshooting indicator transition and an immediate first measurement.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The track owns its background, border and focus-ring paint and the thumb owns its own fill, each on one scoped clock; DOM focus and an unverified caller palette settle that paint immediately.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Switch owns the bounded track box for an explicit size revision, commits the measured destination and remeasures the thumb endpoint from the same change.
